title: Peos Custom Transfurs
description: Adds custom transfurs for the changed mod
body:
This is an addon for the changed mod that currently add's 4 custom transfurs and entity's and even 1 ability.

currently this add's:

Transfurs:

teal dragon (more blue but name was already used)
white mouse
brown mouse
latex mylo panda (this is an oc of a friend named mylo)
forsetti
Latex Drone Wolf
Red Latex Drone Wolf

abilities:

shrink n grow, allows the player to change there size from default to small and back, currently only the white and brown mouse has this.

 

this mod relies on changed 0.15.4 and pehkui 3.8.2+1.20.1-forge please make sure you have these mods installed before playing.
we also have support for changed addon.
 

most importantly have fun.

(currently none of the entity's are able to spawn naturaly)
